001: Did you see Gabriel today? He didn't show up to class.
No, I didn't. I think he got sick, Fernanda told me.
That's too bad! He always does well in class, right?
Yeah. Should we send him a message later?
Good idea. We could also bring him a snack.
Sounds good. I'll check if he needs anything.
002: Do you want to have lunch with me today after class?
Yes, I do! We can go to that new restaurant.
The one that opened near the library?
That's the one, I heard the food is great and the price is good.
Perfect. Then I'll meet you at the classroom door.
003: What did you think of today's exam?
I thought it was hard, especially the last question.
I struggled with it too. Do you think the professor will go over it?
I hope so. We can study together for the next one.
Sounds good. Can you help me with the statistics material?
Of course! We can meet at the library tomorrow.
004: Are you going to the college party on Saturday?
Yes, I am! Are you going too?
I am. Beatriz and Rafael are coming along with us.
That's great! We can meet there at eight.
Sounds good. I'll coordinate with them and let you know.
Perfect. It's going to be fun, for sure.
005: Did you finish the history assignment?
Not yet. I'm having trouble with the final part.
I can take a look if you want.
Really? That would help me a lot, thanks a lot.
No problem! We can meet up after class.
Great. I'll wait for you at the library then.
006: Do you know Camila? She joined our class this semester.
I do, we talked during philosophy class.
She is. She helped me with some notes I had lost.
That's cool! We could invite her to have lunch with us.
Good idea. I'll ask if she's up for it.
007: Did you see your grades for the Portuguese exam?
I did. I got an eight, but I wanted to do better.
An eight is a good grade! I got a seven point five.
Yeah, but I wanted to get at least a nine.
Relax, you'll do well on the next exam.
I hope so. I'll study more for the next one.
008: What are you going to do this weekend?
Nothing much. I'm going to stay home and study.
That's boring! We could go to the movies on Saturday.
That's an idea. What movie do you want to see?
There's a new adventure movie that looks good.
Maybe. I'll finish my studying in the morning and then we'll go.
009: Have you picked your classes for next semester yet?
Yes, I have. I'm taking four classes, including literature.
Good choice. I'm taking three, so it won't be too heavy.
That's good. Last semester I got pretty tired.
Yeah, we need to take care of ourselves too.
010: Do you remember that group project from last year?
I do! We had so much fun doing that project.
We really did. We spent hours at the library together.
And in the end it all worked out, we got a great grade.
Yeah. We made a good team, didn't we?
We sure did. We should do more projects together.
